game.title: Pittsburgh Steelers at New Orleans Saints

lede: Pittsburgh Steelers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#20 in EPA per play), while New Orleans Saints owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#10 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New Orleans Saints −2.0 with a fair total of 46.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Pittsburgh Steelers pass offence vs New Orleans Saints pass defence, which sits −0.119 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
